intro: Your plans. Your pace. One set at a time.
continueText: Pick up exactly where you left off.
emptyHistory: Your story starts with your first workout.
chooseDayText: Pick the session that fits today.
emptyDay: Build this workout by adding your first exercise.
altHelp: Select alternatives from your exercise library. You can add more exercises to any plan first.
confirmRemove: Remove this item from the plan?
finishText: Completed sets are saved to your history. Unfinished sets will be recorded as skipped.
confirmDiscard: Discard this workout and its recorded sets?
altText: Your plan stays the same. Completed sets keep their original exercise and results.
noAlt: No alternatives linked yet. Add them in the plan editor.
saveError: Could not save. Keep this page open and export a backup in Settings.
storageError: Your saved data could not be loaded. Reload to retry; no data has been replaced.
historyIntro: Look back at the work you put in.
storageText: Workouts are saved in this browser on this device. They do not sync between your phone and PC yet. Export a backup before clearing browser data or changing devices.
importText: Import replaces the plans and history on this device. Export your current data first.
confirmImport: Replace all data on this device with this backup?
invalidBackup: This file is not a valid Fitness App backup.
languageHelp: More languages can be added. Your exercise names and notes stay as you entered them.
installText: On iPhone: open this app in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android: use Install app in your browser menu. Open once online to make the app available offline. YouTube videos still need internet.
aboutText: Cloud sync and TV casting are planned for a later version.
validation: Check the values: use positive sets and reps, non-negative weight and rest, and a maximum no lower than the minimum.
invalidVideo: Use an HTTPS YouTube or youtu.be video URL.
newPlanHelp: Name your plan, then add workouts such as Push, Pull and Legs.
noHistorySets: No completed sets in this workout.
progressHelp: Completed sets across your saved workouts.
noProgress: Complete a workout to see your exercise history.
confirmDeletePlan: Delete this plan? Saved workout history will be kept.
planInUse: Finish or discard the active workout before deleting its plan.
pplNote: An empty template. Add your own Push, Pull and Legs exercises.
sourceNote: Based on your uploaded 4-day Upper/Lower plan. Weights are entered during training.
nothingToTrain: Add at least one exercise before starting this workout.
alreadyActive: Resume or finish your active workout first.
weightHelp: Set the convention you use consistently; dumbbell values can be per dumbbell. Assistance is logged separately from added load.
libraryHelp: Create exercises here, then add them to workouts or select them as alternatives.
updateReady: An app update is ready. Close all app tabs and reopen after finishing your workout.
timerNote: Keep the app open for the timer sound. When you return, the remaining time is recalculated.
soundHelp: A short sound plays at the end of rest while the app is open. Sound may be unavailable when the screen is locked.
loadError: Could not load the app. Please reload while online.
